title: Existence of Large Boundary Layer Solutions for the Outflow Problem of Full Compressible Navier-Stokes Equations
summary: We investigate the existence and non-existence of large-amplitude boundary layer solutions to the outflow problem for the one-dimensional full compressible Navier-Stokes equations on the half-line $\mathbb{R}_+$. Through a delicate global phase-plane analysis, we substantially extend the small-amplitude boundary layer solutions obtained via the center-manifold approach to the large-amplitude regime.
